title: Pure Mirror Force
summary: Pure Mirror Force battle-trap control and Critias Fusion build, combining every elemental evolution of Yugi's iconic Trap with Trap-centric tutor engines. The strategy creates a fortress of unpredictable backrow, punishing attacks with mass bounces, permanent face-down flips, board wipes, or Fusion Summoning Mirror Force Dragon to blow up the opponent's entire field.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mirror Force Launcher discards a monster during either player's Main Phase to add Mirror Force from your Deck or GY to hand, and Sets itself and Mirror Force if destroyed while Set.

Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle Special Summons herself from hand when a Normal Trap is activated, cannot be targeted or destroyed while you control a Set card, and Sets a Normal Trap with a different name directly from the Deck whenever a Normal Trap activates.
Lilith, Lady of Lament Tributes a DARK monster as a Quick Effect to reveal three Normal Traps from your Deck for the opponent to randomly Set one to your field.
Trap Trick banishes a Normal Trap from your Deck to Set another copy with the same name that can be activated this turn.

summary.title: Opening: The Fang of Critias + Mirror Force Launcher
steps: Activate or Set Mirror Force Launcher in your Spell & Trap Zone.
Reveal Lord of the Heavenly Prison from your hand to grant complete effect destruction protection to all your Set cards.
Activate Mirror Force Launcher, discarding a monster to search the original Mirror Force from your Deck or GY.
Activate The Fang of Critias, sending Mirror Force from your hand or field to the GY to Special Summon Mirror Force Dragon from your Extra Deck.
Set your remaining elemental Mirror Force Traps (such as Storming Mirror Force or Quaking Mirror Force), threatening a complete board wipe if any monster you control is targeted.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Mirror Force Dragon triggers as a Quick Effect whenever a monster you control is targeted for an attack or by an opponent's card effect, instantly destroying all cards your opponent controls.
Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle provides a 3000 ATK untargetable and indestructible body that continually tutors out whatever elemental Mirror Force best counters the opponent.

Lord of the Heavenly Prison shields all Set cards from effect destruction and Special Summons itself as a 3000 ATK beatstick while setting another Spell/Trap from the Deck when a Set card is activated.
Lilith, Lady of Lament provides Quick Effect backrow fetching while reducing opponent field presence.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mirror Force destroys all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls upon attack declaration, and fuels The Fang of Critias.
Storming Mirror Force returns all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls to the hand without targeting or destruction.
Quaking Mirror Force permanently changes all opposing Attack Position monsters to face-down Defense Position with a battle position lock.
Drowning Mirror Force shuffles all opposing Attack Position monsters into the Deck when they declare a direct attack.
Blazing Mirror Force destroys all Attack Position monsters and burns both players for half their combined original ATK.
The Fang of Critias fuses directly with Mirror Force from hand or field to Special Summon Mirror Force Dragon.
Trap Trick and Mirror Force Launcher ensure consistent access to the exact trap needed for the situation.

main: Mirror Force

The iconic original Normal Trap: when an opponent's monster declares an attack, destroys all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls; also the named material for The Fang of Critias to summon Mirror Force Dragon!
Storming Mirror Force
WIND evolution: when an opponent's monster declares an attack, returns all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls to the hand without targeting or destroying.
Quaking Mirror Force

EARTH evolution: when an opponent's monster declares an attack, changes all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls to face-down Defense Position, and they CANNOT change their battle positions!
Drowning Mirror Force
WATER evolution: when an opponent's monster declares a direct attack, shuffles all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls into the Deck without targeting!
Blazing Mirror Force
FIRE evolution: when an opponent's monster declares an attack, destroys all Attack Position monsters your opponent controls and both players take damage equal to half their combined original ATK.
Radiant Mirror Force
LIGHT evolution: when an opponent's monster declares an attack while they control 3 or more Attack Position monsters, destroys all Attack Position monsters they control.
Dark Mirror Force
DARK evolution: when an opponent's monster declares an attack, banishes all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls.
Mirror Force Launcher

Signature Continuous Trap: discards 1 monster to add 1 'Mirror Force' from Deck or GY to hand; if destroyed while Set by an opponent's effect, Sets itself AND 1 Mirror Force so both can be activated this turn!
The Fang of Critias
Sends 1 'Mirror Force' from your hand or field to the GY to Special Summon Mirror Force Dragon directly from your Extra Deck.
Lady Labrynth of the Silver Castle
Special Summons itself in Defense Position when a Normal Trap is activated, and chains to any Normal Trap to Set the exact Mirror Force variant you need directly from your Deck!
Lord of the Heavenly Prison
Reveals itself in hand so your opponent cannot destroy your Set Mirror Force traps or Mirror Force Launcher with card effects.
Lilith, Lady of Lament
Quick Effect to Tribute itself and Set a Mirror Force Normal Trap directly from your Deck.
Trap Trick
Banishes 1 Mirror Force variant from your Deck to Set another copy that can be activated immediately.
extra: Signature Level 8 LIGHT Dragon Fusion boss ('The Fang of Critias' + 'Mirror Force'; 2800 ATK): whenever a monster you control is targeted for an attack or by an opponent's card effect, destroys ALL cards your opponent controls!
